svg.title: Learned mean actions in the original dog game
svg.desc: At episode 1500, each marker is the 8192-sample estimated action mean for one of ten training seeds, evaluated at the reset state. Circles are red-player means, diamonds blue-player means, and stars show the analytical Nash actions.
svg.text: circle: red · diamond: blue · star: Nash
Seed-level mean actions at the reset state; each mean estimated from 8,192 samples (not individual action samples).
